finding: A narrower controlled-test question is prepared; the inspected records do not supply a completed multi-recorder test, implemented observability solver or validated field pod.
limitations: Preparation reviews selected records and packaging; it is not a new scientific or hardware test.
Original sources and chronological qualifications must not be flattened into a claim of completed marine or biological validation.
Canonical records describe plans; no completed controlled multi-recorder audio and independent geometry result supplied.
Observability implementation is explicitly not begun in the source plan.
Deep, autonomous, open-water, animal and renewed app work remain outside the recorded accepted stage.
